metadata.description: Validation test for Position Hold (docs/fpv-hud-gnss-test-plan.md, T17): in a 3 m/s wind from the north, AUX4 high at 5 s stops the drift and holds; a 30% roll stick (25–28 s) moves the quad and it holds the new point; with the fix lost (45–50 s) it shows POSHOLD FAIL and holds its last angle, then returns.
